# authwise_theme_variants (Data Source)

A theme variant: a theme, changed for one issuer. It names its base theme (`theme_id`) and holds only what differs, key by key, in `stylesheet_attributes` and `content`. What applies, in order: the application's variant (`theme_variant_id`), then the audience's, then the issuer's default variant (`is_default`), then the tenant's default theme.

Formerly `authwise_appearance_profile` (kit#968): a `moved` block from `authwise_appearance_profile` carries the state across. This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `issuer_id` (String) Parent identifier `issuer_id`; overrides the provider default.
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `theme_variants` (Attributes List) Every theme_variant under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--theme_variants))

<a id="nestedatt--theme_variants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `theme_variants`

Read-Only:

- `content` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `name` (String) Full resource name.
- `stylesheet_attributes` (String)
- `theme_id` (String)
- `theme_variant_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
